title: Government impersonation
summary: Someone claims to represent a public authority and demands immediate payment or data.
scenario: The message uses official-looking language, threats, or a deadline to prevent verification.
warning_signs: Threat of arrest, penalty, or service loss
Demand for secrecy or immediate payment
Contact details supplied only by the message
safe_actions: Pause and do not pay or share secrets
Find the authority's contact route independently
Ask a trusted person to help slow the interaction
recovery_guidance: Contact your payment provider if money was sent
Secure accounts and retain the full message
reporting_guidance: Use a reporting route after its source is independently checked
prevention_tips: A threat is not proof of authority
Do not rely on caller ID or logos alone
false_positive_notes: Real notices can be serious, but independent verification remains appropriate.
